WITH club_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM member
), major_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.major_id,
        m.department,
        COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member AS mb
    JOIN major AS m
      ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department
), major_shares AS (
    SELECT
        mc.major_id,
        mc.department,
        mc.member_count,
        CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(cs.total_members, 0) AS share
    FROM major_counts AS mc
    CROSS JOIN club_size AS cs
), ranked_shares AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        department,
        member_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_average
    FROM major_shares
)
SELECT
    major_id,
    department,
    member_count,
    share,
    share - department_average AS above_department_average
FROM ranked_shares
WHERE share > department_average
ORDER BY above_department_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A major's share is its member count divided by the total club membership; majors with no matching members are omitted because the request first matches members to majors and counts those matches.
